entries.test: SoftBank's disclosures and contemporaneous reporting would establish whether it sold its entire Nvidia holding by the post date.
entries.note: The title supports the ominous-sign framing; the sale is the checkable factual claim.

entries.test: Public credit-rating announcements would establish whether Oracle's debt had recently been downgraded by the post date.
entries.note: A downgrade of a rating outlook alone would not establish a debt-rating downgrade.

entries.test: Contemporaneous reporting and Meta's public financial disclosures would establish whether financing arrangements involving financial engineering had recently been revealed.
entries.note: The source does not specify AI infrastructure, which the normalization adds. 'Financing games' supplies an evaluative characterization of the asserted disclosures.

entries.test: Public recordings or transcripts of Altman's relevant remarks would show whether he supplied an explanation of how OpenAI would meet the stated $1.4 trillion in obligations.
entries.note: The plain reading concerns his public answer, rather than an unknowable private capacity to explain.

entries.test: CoreWeave's historical stock prices would establish whether its shares fell approximately 20% over the week preceding the post.
entries.note: Stock price is the ordinary reading of the company's percentage drop in this financial context.
The closing invitation implies concern but does not assert the drafter's specific conclusion of serious industry trouble.
